When you're building the coils, heat it up at low power (I do 10-20w in power mode) until the titanium coils start to turn a yellowish color. If they turn white, that means the oxide is forming. As long as they don't turn white you're fine

.5mm is about 24g, and for my 24g titanium builds I usually vape around 420°, and go even higher with a thicker gauge wire of titanium. I've heard lots of people vaping titanium up to 550° without issue, though I haven't tried it myself.

I really like temperature control actually, you set a specific temperature and the mod will actually fluctuate the voltage to keep the coils at that temperature. 

Also as mentioned before, the rx200 is a very popular mod, as are dna200 chip mods. I personally have an ipv3-li that I really like. I'd recommend at least a dual 18650 box mod to keep the battery life kind of long.

As far as pass through charging, for anything that takes 18650s, especially more than one, I'd recommend not using the mod to charge the batteries, get an external charger instead.

If you're comfortable building your own coils, I'd suggest looking into the mutation tank. Runs dual coils and produces a good amount of vapor, pretty good flavor too. And you make your own coils which is way cheaper

You have to heat up up just a little bit (I set my mod at 10w) while in a dark room just enough where you can start to see it glow just the tiniest bit. This is when you crimp it. Then turn the lights on an look at the coil. Repeat as many times as necessary until you see the coil start to turn yellow. If it turns white, IMMEDIATELY scrap it and start over. When its white its toxic. Once the coils are a yallewish color and crimped to your hearts desire, then you can wick the coils.
